record.label: Synthesized Tucker / quotient nested-HT CP3 recompression
record.summary: The r64/r96 Tucker fallback was superseded by the more expressive frozen r128/k32 quotient nested-HT teacher reconstruction. Even this favorable source-only screen fails: quotient raw MSE is 6.77351956876131e-8 and the unprojected raw control is 6.66858015624021e-8 versus a 3.060640051205329e-8 gate at 551,371,243,519 projected FLOPs. Receipt SHA-256 b2080ee26fc6c9b3b2715ffc502d3bed4798a7b132a29e76df7c3227f82e68bd.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed because the teacher-capacity upper bound itself misses the literal raw gate by more than 2x; no autonomous HT implementation is licensed.
